title: A UI test of a trigger must show the result was absent before the trigger
rule: When a Playwright or component test proves that a control (a button, a menu item, a key) causes a result (a badge, a note, a list), assert that the result is absent right before the action, after every earlier step of the test has settled. An earlier step that reaches the same store action (turning a feature on, a first refresh, a load) can produce the result already, and then the test still passes with the control's handler removed. If an earlier step must not cause the result, make that a rule in the store and test it there too. Check the test once by removing the handler: it must fail.
rationale: E22.4 (#149): the e2e test clicked Check for updates and asserted the badges, but turning the catalog on had already run a refresh that compared, so the badges were on screen before the click and removing @click failed no test.
